name: Clarice Foster
summary: In the Pools of Vision, Clarice Foster dwells among tauren seers and mystics. Far from Lordaeron, the Forsaken woman spends her days in contemplation beneath the bluffs of Mulgore.

sections.title: A Forsaken in the Pools of Vision
sections.body: Most Forsaken remain in Lordaeron, rebuilding their kingdom beneath the Undercity. Clarice Foster has crossed to Kalimdor and the heart of tauren lands. She lives in the cavernous Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff's mesa. There she dwells among Forsaken apothecaries and tauren shamans who study the earth's spiritual and elemental mysteries.

faq.answer: Clarice Foster is a Forsaken woman dwelling in the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff. An envoy among the tauren of Mulgore, she is one of the few undead visitors who live with them.

faq.q: Where can I find Clarice Foster?
faq.answer: You can find Clarice Foster in the Pools of Vision, a cave complex beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff.

aliases: until death do us part quest
faq.answer: Clarice Foster offers Until Death Do Us Part. Bitter that her late husband left her to fight the undead and died, she sends travelers to lay his pendant on his tomb at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.

angles.text: As Forsaken, Clarice Foster reflects your people's ties to their tauren allies in Kalimdor, far from Tirisfal and Silverpine's blight-stained soil.
As a tauren, you see Clarice Foster welcomed into the sacred Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise. Her presence shows your people's willingness to host unconventional newcomers to the Horde.
